jobs.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
jobs.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. Summary: We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do:: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications:: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have):: Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: GTM AI Operations - India
jobs.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. What You'll Be Doing:: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives:: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For:: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications:: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability:: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

needs_verification.title: Product Enablement Specialist II
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Mobile App Lifecycle Management: Independently manage a portfolio of white-label mobile applications throughout onboarding, development coordination, store submission, launch, and ongoing updates. App Store Submissions: Prepare, submit, and maintain applications on Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console, ensuring compliance with platform requirements and submission guidelines. Rejection Investigation and Resolution: Analyze app review rejections from Apple and Google, identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and coordinate resubmissions to minimize launch delays. Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve complex issues involving developer accounts, app builds, metadata, configurations, permissions, certificates, provisioning, API keys, and submission workflows before escalating to Engineering. Proactive Blocker Management: Identify applications experiencing submission delays or stalled progress, determine the next required actions, and proactively coordinate solutions to keep projects moving. Customer Support and Escalation Management: Handle complex customer cases, conduct troubleshooting calls when necessary, and provide clear, practical guidance to customers and agency owners. Developer Account Guidance: Help agency owners navigate Apple Developer Program requirements, Google Play Console configurations, account verification, agreements, access permissions, and application transfers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate technical escalations with Product and Engineering teams, communicate relevant findings, validate fixes, and ensure that reported issues are resolved effectively. Mobile App Testing and Validation: Perform end-to-end testing of mobile app workflows and verify that technical fixes, configurations, and updates work as expected before proceeding with submissions or releases. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document recurring app rejection scenarios, troubleshooting procedures, and successful resolutions to improve internal knowledge resources and operational consistency. Team Enablement: Support Product Enablement Specialist I team members by answering process-related questions, sharing troubleshooting expertise, and helping them resolve application issues more efficiently. Operational Improvement: Identify recurring technical and operational challenges, recommend process improvements, and contribute to reducing repeated submission failures and unnecessary escalations. Performance and Reporting: Maintain accurate application records, monitor progress across assigned apps, prepare operational reports, and ensure compliance with established service-level agreements (SLAs). Requirements: Professional Experience: Approximately 2–4 years of experience in SaaS, technical support, product operations, product enablement, application support, or a related field. Apple App Ecosystem: Working knowledge of the Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, iOS application submission procedures, and app review requirements. Google Play Ecosystem: Familiarity with Google Play Console, Android app submission processes, developer account management, and store compliance requirements. App Submission Troubleshooting: Demonstrated ability to investigate app review rejections, submission blockers, configuration problems, and account-related issues independently. Mobile Application Fundamentals: Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Notification Services: Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), or comparable mobile notification technologies. Developer Account Administration: Ability to manage account access, user permissions, agreements, verification requirements, and app transfers across Apple and Google platforms. Technical Investigation: Ability to diagnose build, configuration, access, and submission issues before escalating them to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON and configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Testing and Quality Assurance: Ability to validate technical fixes and conduct end-to-end testing to ensure mobile applications function correctly throughout critical workflows. Data Analysis and Reporting: Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions to complex problems. Customer Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear, actionable explanations for customers and non-technical stakeholders. Ownership and Independence: A proactive mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to investigate and resolve complex issues with limited supervision. Organization and Prioritization: Ability to manage multiple applications and customer cases simultaneously, prioritize urgent blockers, and meet deadlines and SLA requirements. Collaboration and Mentoring: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with customers, agency owners, Product and Engineering teams, and junior specialists. Continuous Improvement: A willingness to document new findings, share knowledge, improve workflows, and help reduce recurring operational issues. Preferred Experience: Previous experience with a SaaS or CRM platform, particularly white-label mobile app solutions, is beneficial. Familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools is also an advantage. Benefits: Remote Work: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility of a distributed working environment. Career Development: Build specialized expertise in mobile app publishing, technical troubleshooting, SaaS operations, and product enablement. Technical Growth: Gain hands-on experience with Apple and Google developer ecosystems, mobile application configurations, notification services, and app lifecycle management. Increased Ownership: Independently manage complex application portfolios and take responsibility for technical problem-solving and customer outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and improve application workflows. Knowledge Sharing: Develop leadership skills by mentoring junior specialists and contributing to internal documentation and process improvements. Continuous Learning: Explore emerging tools and technologies, including AI-powered productivity solutions, to improve troubleshooting and operational efficiency. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

needs_verification.title: Product Enablement Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Independently manage a portfolio of white-label mobile applications from onboarding through launch, submission, and ongoing maintenance. Prepare, submit, and manage applications across the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, ensuring compliance with platform requirements. Investigate and resolve application rejections, submission blockers, developer account issues, build failures, metadata problems, configuration errors, and access-related challenges. Identify applications experiencing delays or stalled progress and proactively determine the appropriate next steps to move them forward. Handle complex customer cases and lead troubleshooting calls when necessary, translating technical issues into clear and actionable guidance. Guide agency owners through Apple Developer and Google Play Console requirements, including account setup, permissions, agreements, verification, and app transfers. Coordinate technical escalations with Product and Engineering teams, providing relevant diagnostic information and validating solutions before closing issues. Document new rejection scenarios, troubleshooting methods, and successful resolutions to strengthen team knowledge and consistency. Support Product Enablement Specialist I colleagues by answering process questions and sharing technical troubleshooting expertise. Identify recurring operational challenges and recommend improvements to workflows, documentation, and submission processes. Maintain service-level agreement (SLA) compliance, accurate application tracking, and reliable reporting across the assigned portfolio. Perform end-to-end testing of mobile application workflows and verify fixes to ensure successful outcomes. Requirements: Typically 2–4 years of experience in SaaS, technical support, product operations, product enablement, or a related technical or customer-facing role. Working knowledge of Apple Developer, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, and iOS and Android application submission processes. Experience troubleshooting application review rejections, submission failures, and related technical blockers. Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Ability to manage developer account access, permissions, agreements, verification processes, and application transfers. Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging, or comparable mobile notification technologies. Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Ability to investigate build, configuration, account, and submission issues independently before escalating to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON, configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting capabilities, and sound judgment when managing complex technical issues. Experience managing customer escalations and handling multiple applications or cases simultaneously with minimal supervision. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical problems and solutions clearly to non-technical audiences. Strong ownership, organization, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Familiarity with the Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, app review management, or SaaS and CRM platforms is preferred. Experience with HighLevel or similar platforms, as well as AI-powered productivity tools, is an added advantage. Benefits: Remote work arrangement within India. Opportunity to develop expertise in mobile application publishing, platform compliance, and technical troubleshooting across iOS and Android. Exposure to SaaS product operations and collaboration with Product and Engineering teams. Opportunities to contribute to operational improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. A role with meaningful ownership, independent problem-solving, and opportunities to support the development of other team members. needs_verification.title: Salesforce Service Cloud Administrator
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Salesforce Platform Administration: Manage the day-to-day administration of Salesforce Service Cloud, ensuring system stability, usability, performance, and operational efficiency. Configuration and Enhancements: Configure and maintain custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, Salesforce Flows, and other platform features to support evolving business needs. User Access Management: Assist with user onboarding, account setup, permissions, profiles, and role-based access controls to maintain appropriate and secure platform access. User Support and Troubleshooting: Provide frontline assistance to Salesforce users, investigate technical issues, respond to support requests, and implement solutions that minimize operational disruptions. Business Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with operations and support teams to understand business needs, document requirements, and translate them into practical Salesforce configurations and enhancements. AI and Intelligent Automation: Support the configuration, testing, and monitoring of Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce agents and intelligent service automation workflows. Integration Support: Collaborate with technical teams to define, test, monitor, and troubleshoot MuleSoft integrations connecting Salesforce Service Cloud with Jira, Workday, and other business applications. Integration Monitoring: Assist with API connectivity, authentication, data mapping, connector configuration, and flow monitoring to maintain reliable data exchange and synchronized workflows across platforms. Data Quality and Governance: Monitor data integrity, perform data cleanup, and support governance practices that maintain accurate, consistent, and reliable Salesforce records. Testing and Deployment: Participate in testing, validation, and deployment activities for platform updates, new features, automation changes, and system improvements. Reporting and Documentation: Maintain reports, dashboards, configuration records, process documentation, and user guides to support transparency, knowledge sharing, and efficient platform management. Sales Cloud Alignment: Maintain a working understanding of Sales Cloud processes and data structures to support consistency across the broader Salesforce ecosystem. Telephony and Service Operations: Support awareness of AWS telephony workflows for inbound and outbound contact handling and their interaction with customer service processes. Requirements Professional Experience: At least 3 years of experience working with Salesforce administration, configuration, support, or platform enhancement. Salesforce Certification: Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) is preferred. Service Cloud Expertise: Practical experience supporting Salesforce Service Cloud environments and understanding their role in customer service operations. Salesforce Configuration: Familiarity with configuring custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and user access settings. Automation Skills: Working knowledge of Salesforce Flow or similar automation tools is preferred. Salesforce AI Knowledge: Exposure to Salesforce AI capabilities, such as Agentforce or Einstein AI, and an interest in implementing intelligent automation solutions. MuleSoft and Integration Knowledge: Familiarity with MuleSoft integration capabilities, connectors, APIs, authentication methods, data mapping, and flow monitoring, particularly for integrations between Salesforce, Jira, Workday, and related enterprise platforms. Sales Cloud Awareness: Basic understanding of Sales Cloud concepts, standard objects, and data structures to help maintain alignment across Salesforce applications. Telephony Experience: Knowledge of AWS telephony platforms and inbound and outbound contact-handling workflows is an advantage. Technical and Analytical Skills: Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to investigate issues and identify effective solutions. Business Process Understanding: Ability to translate operational requirements into practical technical configurations and communicate system capabilities to non-technical stakeholders. Communication and Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, business users, and stakeholders across different functions. Documentation and Organization: Excellent attention to detail, documentation practices, and organizational skills to manage multiple requests and maintain reliable system records. Adaptability: Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment. Language Proficiency: Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Benefits Remote-First Flexibility: Work remotely from India with flexibility to organize your schedule around professional responsibilities and personal commitments. Competitive Leave Package: Access to a competitive leave policy, including paid bonding leave for eligible family-related milestones. Paid Volunteering Leave: Receive two paid charitable days off each year to support causes that matter to you. Annual Incentives: Eligibility for an annual corporate bonus scheme or applicable sales incentive plan. Global Collaboration: Work with colleagues across countries and cultures, expanding your international network and professional perspective. People-Centered Culture: Join a collaborative environment that values mutual respect, recognizes contributions, and encourages employees to share ideas with leadership. Learning and Development: Access two learning platforms to build technical expertise, develop new skills, and support continuous professional growth. needs_verification.title: Site Navigator I
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Site Identification and Feasibility: Identify potential investigative sites that meet study requirements, assess their capabilities and resources, conduct initial outreach, obtain confidentiality agreements, and coordinate feasibility questionnaires. Site Start-Up and Activation: Coordinate site-level start-up activities from feasibility through activation, tracking milestones, deadlines, submissions, and outstanding requirements to ensure timely study initiation. Regulatory Compliance and Documentation: Collect, review, track, and maintain essential site documents in accordance with ICH/GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, standard operating procedures, and study-specific requirements. Pre-Study Visits: Coordinate remote pre-study visits, including preparation, follow-up activities, visit reports, and supporting documentation required for site selection and activation. Regulatory Submissions: Prepare and coordinate submissions to Institutional Review Boards (IRBs), Independent Ethics Committees (IECs), applicable third parties, and regulatory authorities in collaboration with the relevant regulatory submissions team. Informed Consent Management: Review and support the customization and translation of informed consent forms and patient-facing materials to meet country-specific and local regulatory requirements. Site Maintenance and Regulatory Oversight: Monitor document expirations, annual ethics committee renewals, principal investigator changes, and other ongoing compliance requirements throughout the study, as applicable. Contract and Budget Coordination: Conduct initial contract and budget negotiations with investigative sites and support amendments when required, ensuring alignment with study scope and budget expectations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with project leadership, Clinical Research Associates (CRAs), study leads, sponsors, CRO personnel, vendors, and site staff to coordinate deliverables and resolve operational issues. Site Initiation Support: Assist CRA teams in preparing for site initiation visits by coordinating clinical supplies, system access, documentation, and other site readiness requirements. Risk Management and Escalation: Participate in study team meetings, identify site-level risks and performance issues, develop action plans, and escalate concerns promptly to protect project timelines and study quality. Trial Master File Management: Ensure accurate, timely, and consistent filing of essential documents in applicable systems and maintain an audit-ready Trial Master File (TMF). Clinical Data Quality and Monitoring Support: Perform Case Report Form (CRF) reviews and data validation against source documentation, as applicable, while supporting the identification of protocol deviations, serious adverse event reporting requirements, and other study compliance matters. Operational Excellence: Exercise independent judgment in managing site activities, resolving issues, prioritizing competing deadlines, and completing additional responsibilities in line with operational requirements and internal training. Requirements Education: A university or college degree, preferably in life sciences, or a relevant qualification in an allied health profession, such as nursing, medical technology, or laboratory technology. Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. Alternative Qualification Pathway: Candidates with a high school diploma or equivalent and at least five years of clinical research experience, including strong knowledge of applicable regulations, may also be considered. Professional Experience: At least one year of experience in a related field, such as clinical research, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, laboratory research, data analysis, data management, or technical writing. Previous clinical research experience is preferred. Clinical Research Knowledge: Basic understanding of ICH/GCP guidelines, regulatory authority requirements, IRB/IEC processes, and applicable clinical trial regulations. Site Start-Up Experience: Familiarity with investigator site start-up documentation, feasibility assessments, regulatory submissions, site activation processes, and contract and budget negotiations is advantageous. Protocol Understanding: Ability to interpret clinical study protocols and understand their implications for site readiness, documentation, compliance, and study execution. Documentation and Quality Control: Strong attention to detail and the ability to review, organize, track, and maintain accurate regulatory and essential study documents. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the applicable local official language, with the ability to communicate effectively with site personnel, sponsors, CRO teams, and regulatory stakeholders. Organization and Time Management: Ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and strict deadlines while maintaining accuracy and consistency. Problem-Solving and Judgment: Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify potential site start-up challenges, resolve routine issues, and escalate complex concerns appropriately. Negotiation and Coordination: Ability to support contract and budget negotiations, coordinate cross-functional activities, and maintain productive relationships with investigative sites. Compliance Mindset: Commitment to patient rights, safety, confidentiality, regulatory compliance, and the ethical conduct of clinical research. Remote Work Readiness: Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and collaborate with geographically distributed clinical research teams. Benefits Remote Work: Remote-based working arrangement, with possible office attendance depending on location. Limited Travel: Travel requirements are limited primarily to training. Professional Development: Opportunity to strengthen expertise in clinical trial start-up, regulatory documentation, site management, and clinical research operations. Cross-Functional Exposure: Work collaboratively with sponsors, CRO teams, investigators, regulatory stakeholders, and clinical operations professionals. Career Growth: Opportunity to develop clinical research knowledge and take on additional responsibilities aligned with operational needs and internal training. Meaningful Impact: Contribute to the successful delivery of clinical studies while supporting participant safety, regulatory compliance, and research quality. Compensation and Additional Benefits: Salary, healthcare coverage, paid leave, and other benefits were not specified in the original job description and should be confirmed during recruitment. needs_verification.title: Data Governance Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Data Governance Platform Administration: Configure, administer, and enhance Collibra Data Intelligence Cloud and other data governance and catalog platforms to support enterprise-wide governance requirements. Operating Model and Workflow Configuration: Customize governance operating models, domains, communities, assets, and workflows to align platform capabilities with business needs and organizational structures. Business Glossary and Data Ownership: Develop and maintain business glossaries, data dictionaries, data ownership models, and stewardship practices to improve consistency and clarity across business domains. Metadata Management and Cataloging: Ingest, organize, and maintain technical and business metadata from enterprise systems, ensuring data assets are documented, discoverable, and governed effectively. Data Lineage and Impact Analysis: Enable automated and manual data lineage, facilitate impact analysis, and support data certification to improve visibility into data flows, dependencies, and reliability. Governance Policies and Compliance: Define and operationalize data governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls that support regulatory obligations and internal compliance requirements. Platform Integrations: Manage integrations between governance platforms, cloud data environments, business intelligence tools, and metadata sources to maintain consistent information across systems. Data Quality Collaboration: Work with data quality teams to surface relevant data quality rules, metrics, and information within governance processes, supporting trusted and reliable data. Stakeholder Engagement and Asset Onboarding: Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to identify, onboard, and govern data assets across multiple domains. Training and Adoption: Deliver training and guidance for data owners, data stewards, and platform users to encourage adoption of data governance tools and established processes. Continuous Improvement: Monitor governance platform effectiveness, identify gaps in metadata coverage and stewardship, and recommend improvements to operating models, workflows, and governance practices. Requirements: Professional Experience: At least five years of experience in data governance, data management, or a related field. Hands-On Platform Expertise: At least three years of practical experience with master data management (MDM) and data governance software, including implementation, configuration, or administration. Collibra Experience: Experience configuring and administering Collibra Data Intelligence Cloud in a production environment, including domains, communities, assets, workflows, and governance operating models. Data Governance Frameworks: Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, operating models, data ownership, stewardship, and the processes needed to establish effective enterprise governance. Metadata and Data Cataloging: Practical knowledge of metadata management, data cataloging, business glossaries, data dictionaries, and technical and business metadata ingestion. Data Lineage: Experience implementing or supporting automated and manual data lineage, impact analysis, and metadata traceability across systems. Additional Governance Platforms: Familiarity with other data governance and cataloging solutions, including Informatica and DataHub. Cloud and BI Integrations: Experience integrating governance tools with cloud data platforms and analytics environments. Familiarity with Snowflake, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is an advantage. Data Quality Knowledge: Understanding of data quality tools, processes, rules, and metrics, with the ability to collaborate with data quality teams to improve data reliability. Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with relevant data protection and compliance requirements, such as GDPR, CCPA, or SOX, is beneficial. Communication and Stakeholder Management: Strong communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to align business and technical stakeholders and explain governance concepts clearly. Attention to Detail: A structured, detail-oriented approach to metadata management, documentation, platform configuration, and governance controls. Change Management and Collaboration: Ability to encourage adoption of governed data practices, support cultural change, and move cross-functional initiatives forward effectively. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote, full-time opportunity based in India. Enterprise Data Governance: Opportunity to help build and scale data governance programs and improve how enterprise data is managed, discovered, and trusted. Modern Technology Exposure: Hands-on work with leading data governance and catalog platforms, metadata management solutions, cloud data environments, and integration technologies. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with business, data, analytics, and IT professionals on initiatives that connect technology capabilities with organizational objectives. Professional Growth: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in Collibra, data governance frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and enterprise data strategy. Meaningful Business Impact: Contribute to improved data transparency, regulatory compliance, data quality, and informed decision-making. Inclusive Workplace: Equal employment opportunity and a commitment to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Compensation and Additional Benefits: Salary details, healthcare coverage, paid leave, bonuses, and other specific benefits were not provided in the original job description. needs_verification.title: Associate Clinical Operations Leader
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Clinical Team Coordination: Coordinate and guide clinical project team members on small to midsize studies, establish productivity targets, provide performance feedback, and contribute to study-specific training. Study Start-Up and Planning: Support study initiation activities by contributing to project plans, site selection strategies, monitoring plans, and patient recruitment and retention strategies. Study Performance Monitoring: Track project timelines, patient enrollment and retention, site performance, and data-cleaning progress to support timely, high-quality study delivery. Site Management and Issue Resolution: Address escalated site issues, identify operational risks early, conduct root cause analysis, and support the development and implementation of contingency plans. Stakeholder Communication: Maintain effective communication with internal teams, sponsors, clinical investigators and research sites, external customers, and third-party vendors, responding promptly to urgent requests and emerging concerns. Resource Management: Assess project staffing and resource requirements, monitor resource utilization throughout the study life cycle, and support efficient allocation of clinical operations resources. Regulatory Compliance and Quality Assurance: Ensure study activities comply with International Council for Harmonisation Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP), applicable local regulatory requirements, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and operational guidelines. Audit and Inspection Readiness: Prepare for and participate in audits and inspections, maintain accurate study documentation, and support the quality review and upkeep of central study files. Study Close-Out and Data Management: Collaborate with project leaders and data operations teams on database lock, project close-out, documentation, and archiving activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with global project management teams and cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate deliverables, resolve operational challenges, and maintain alignment across study activities. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to process improvement initiatives, document lessons learned during study close-out, and identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and study quality. Team Development: Act as a positive role model, share clinical operations knowledge, and help foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning across virtual teams. Requirements: Education: A degree in life sciences, a nursing qualification, or equivalent relevant clinical or clinical management experience. Clinical Research Experience: Substantial experience in clinical research operations, including experience as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or in an equivalent clinical research role. Clinical Trial Knowledge: Strong understanding of the full clinical trial life cycle, including study start-up, site management, monitoring, data cleaning, close-out, and archiving. Regulatory and Compliance Expertise: Knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, local regulatory requirements, clinical trial procedures, and applicable quality standards. Clinical Coordination Experience: Experience coordinating clinical activities or teams is preferred, particularly experience gained in a Senior CRA or Senior Clinical Management Associate (CMA) position. Monitoring Experience: Previous on-site clinical monitoring experience is an advantage. Leadership and Stakeholder Management: Ability to coordinate virtual teams across different locations and cultures, influence stakeholders diplomatically, negotiate effectively, and build trusted working relationships. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong root cause analysis, issue resolution, and critical-thinking abilities, with the capacity to anticipate risks and implement practical solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent written and spoken English, with proficiency in relevant local languages where required for assigned countries. Organization and Time Management: Strong planning, prioritization, and multitasking skills, combined with attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and a commitment to high-quality work. Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook, as well as WebEx or comparable collaboration tools. Willingness to learn and become proficient in relevant clinical operations systems. Adaptability and Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, respond to changing study needs, and contribute positively to a fast-paced, international environment. Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel when required by assigned studies or project responsibilities. Benefits: Remote Work: Work remotely from India, with the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across global locations. Flexible Work Environment: Be part of an organization that values flexibility and supports employees in doing their best work. Professional Development: Expand your clinical research expertise while developing project coordination, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Career Growth: Gain exposure to small and midsize clinical studies, cross-functional project management, and opportunities to broaden your responsibilities. Meaningful Impact: Contribute to clinical research that supports the development of new therapies and helps improve patient outcomes. Collaborative Culture: Work with experienced clinical operations professionals in a diverse, internationally connected team. Continuous Learning: Strengthen your knowledge of clinical trial processes, regulatory compliance, study quality, and operational best practices. Process Improvement Opportunities: Participate in initiatives that enhance clinical research efficiency, quality, and delivery. needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Serve as the primary administrator for Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, ensuring platform stability, performance, security, and usability. Manage users, profiles, permission sets, roles, access controls, and sharing settings in accordance with business requirements and security best practices. Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Salesforce Flow automations, including record-triggered, scheduled, screen, and HTTP callout flows. Review, rationalize, and migrate legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builder automations to modern Salesforce automation solutions where appropriate. Build and maintain reports and dashboards that provide visibility into sales pipelines, operational performance, subscription revenue, and key business metrics, including monthly recurring revenue (MRR), annual recurring revenue (ARR), and churn. Administer Case Management workflows, assignment rules, service processes, and related automation to improve service delivery and operational efficiency. Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and connected platforms, including NetSuite through Celigo/integrator.io, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Dialpad, PDF Butler, Apollo, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams. Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot API-based and webhook-based integrations to maintain reliable data synchronization across business systems. Support deployment and release management activities across sandbox and production environments using change sets, Metadata API, and Salesforce CLI. Maintain data integrity through validation rules, regular audits, duplicate management, data cleanup, and continuous process improvements. Investigate and resolve end-user issues, provide technical support, and develop clear documentation and training materials to encourage effective platform adoption. Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across departments to understand operational challenges and deliver scalable Salesforce solutions. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve automation, and strengthen Revenue Operations (RevOps) processes. Use AI-assisted tools to support administration, troubleshooting, documentation, and process optimization while maintaining quality and appropriate oversight. Stay informed about Salesforce platform releases, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve the environment. Requirements: 8+ years of hands-on Salesforce Administration experience , preferably in complex, highly automated environments. A valid Salesforce Administrator certification is required. Strong practical expertise in Salesforce Flow automation, including designing, implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting advanced flows. Proven administration experience across both Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Strong understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and access management. Experience managing third-party integrations and troubleshooting API-based and webhook-based data synchronization. Demonstrated ability to build and maintain reports and dashboards for sales, service operations, financial reporting, and business performance monitoring. Experience supporting data quality initiatives, automation improvements, release management, and platform maintenance. Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools and processes, including change sets, Metadata API, and Salesforce CLI. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex operational and technical issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical processes and explain solutions to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions to improve administration workflows, technical troubleshooting, and documentation. Preferred qualifications: Salesforce Advanced Administrator and/or Platform App Builder certification. Experience integrating Salesforce with NetSuite and middleware platforms such as Celigo/integrator.io. Familiarity with HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Dialpad, PDF Butler, Apollo, or comparable business applications. Experience working with subscription-based business models and metrics, including MRR, ARR, and customer churn. Exposure to low-code/no-code automation practices and Revenue Operations workflows. Salesforce Platform Developer I certification. Experience in healthcare, SaaS, marketing, or agency environments. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Insurance Benefits Verification: Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, benefits, and policy details to ensure information is accurate and complete before services are provided or claims are submitted. Patient and Provider Communication: Communicate with patients, healthcare providers, and insurance representatives to clarify coverage details, confirm benefits, and address insurance-related questions. Documentation and Recordkeeping: Accurately record verification results, update patient information, and maintain complete documentation in electronic health records (EHR) systems and designated verification platforms. Discrepancy Resolution: Identify inconsistencies in insurance information, investigate coverage issues, and follow up on pending verifications to support timely resolution. Medical Billing Support: Collaborate with billing and other internal teams to ensure verified insurance information supports accurate claims preparation and timely submission. Policy and Compliance Management: Stay informed about insurance policies, payer requirements, and verification procedures while adhering to established operational standards and healthcare regulations. Workflow Coordination: Manage verification requests efficiently, prioritize workloads, and maintain turnaround times to support seamless healthcare administrative operations. Team Collaboration and Training: Work with colleagues across departments to improve processes and provide guidance or training to junior team members when required. Quality Assurance: Review verification information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, helping reduce administrative errors and prevent avoidable billing delays. Requirements Professional Experience: At least 3 years of experience in insurance verification, verification of benefits, medical billing, or a closely related healthcare administration role. Medical Billing Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical billing and coding practices, insurance eligibility, benefit structures, coverage limitations, and claims processing workflows. EHR and Verification Systems: Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) systems and insurance verification software, with the ability to navigate digital platforms and maintain accurate patient records. Insurance Verification Expertise: Ability to interpret insurance information, confirm patient benefits, identify discrepancies, and follow up effectively with relevant parties. Healthcare Compliance: Knowledge of HIPAA regulations, patient confidentiality requirements, and applicable healthcare data protection and compliance standards. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with patients, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong attention to detail and the ability to investigate discrepancies, assess information accurately, and resolve issues efficiently. Organization and Time Management: Ability to handle multiple verification requests, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent accuracy in a fast-paced environment. Independent Working Style: Comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision while remaining accountable for productivity, documentation quality, and timely follow-up. Teamwork and Adaptability: Willingness to collaborate across departments, adapt to changing workflows, and contribute to continuous process improvement. Benefits Remote Work Opportunity: Work remotely from India. Healthcare Operations Experience: Develop and apply specialized expertise in insurance verification, patient benefits, and medical billing workflows. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with healthcare providers, patients, and internal teams to support efficient administrative and claims processes. needs_verification.title: Revenue Analytics Analyst
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Metrics definition and governance: Define, document, and certify company-wide business metrics, including ARR, ACV, NDR, GDR, customer count, and employee count, ensuring each metric has a consistent, clearly governed definition. Executive-level reporting: Own the certification of metrics used in company-wide and executive reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting cycles and business reviews. Data quality and reconciliation: Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies across source systems, including Salesforce, NetSuite, customer success platforms, and product data, to maintain the integrity of governed metrics. Governance standards: Establish and maintain data quality controls, data lineage documentation, metric ownership frameworks, and governance processes that can scale with organizational growth. Reporting automation: Partner with business intelligence, data products, AI, and data engineering teams to develop an automation roadmap that reduces manual reconciliation and enables reliable, self-service reporting. Cross-functional alignment: Serve as the primary point of contact for Finance, Go-to-Market, General and Administrative (G&A), Product, and Engineering stakeholders on company-wide metric definitions, reporting questions, and changes to measurement standards. Metric consistency and standardization: Identify and close gaps between departmental reporting practices, ensuring teams use consistent definitions for shared business performance indicators. Continuous improvement: Evaluate existing reporting processes, identify opportunities to improve data reliability and accessibility, and implement scalable solutions that strengthen confidence in business performance insights. Clear ownership boundaries: Maintain centralized ownership of company-wide metrics while enabling functional teams to retain responsibility for their own operational analytics and specialized reporting needs. Requirements At least two years of relevant professional experience in revenue analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, financial analytics, or a related field. Demonstrated experience defining, managing, or governing company-wide business metrics within a B2B Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment. Strong understanding of subscription business metrics, including ARR, ACV, NDR, GDR, customer counts, and related revenue performance indicators. Advanced practical SQL skills, with the ability to query, analyze, reconcile, and validate complex datasets across multiple business systems. Experience working with data from CRM, finance, customer success, and product platforms, ideally including Salesforce and NetSuite. Strong understanding of data quality management, metric standardization, reporting governance, data lineage, and source-of-truth management. Ability to investigate data discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions that improve reporting accuracy and consistency. Familiarity with business intelligence tools, data products, data engineering workflows, and reporting automation initiatives. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data issues into clear, actionable recommendations. Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities, including the confidence to align cross-functional teams on metric definitions and governance standards. A detail-oriented, structured, and proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a remote environment. A strong sense of ownership and accountability for the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of business-critical data. Benefits Competitive compensation: Annual salary ranging from INR 15,00,000 to INR 25,00,000 (₹15–25 LPA), depending on experience and suitability. Fully remote work: Work remotely from India, offering flexibility without the need for a daily office commute. Strategic business impact: Influence executive-level decision-making by ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the company's most important performance metrics. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Finance, GTM, Product, Engineering, and data specialists across the organization. Professional development: Strengthen your expertise in revenue analytics, data governance, subscription business metrics, and enterprise reporting. Data and automation focus: Contribute to initiatives that modernize reporting, improve data quality, and enable scalable, self-service analytics. Ownership and autonomy: Take responsibility for establishing trusted metric definitions and governance standards across the business. Full-time opportunity: Build your career in a role that combines technical analytics expertise with strategic business partnership. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? strong_shortlist.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. Summary: We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do:: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications:: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have):: Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

strong_shortlist.title: GTM AI Operations - India
strong_shortlist.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. What You'll Be Doing:: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives:: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For:: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications:: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability:: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote
