verification_backlog.title: Associate Clinical Operations Leader
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Clinical Team Coordination: Coordinate and guide clinical project team members on small to midsize studies, establish productivity targets, provide performance feedback, and contribute to study-specific training. Study Start-Up and Planning: Support study initiation activities by contributing to project plans, site selection strategies, monitoring plans, and patient recruitment and retention strategies. Study Performance Monitoring: Track project timelines, patient enrollment and retention, site performance, and data-cleaning progress to support timely, high-quality study delivery. Site Management and Issue Resolution: Address escalated site issues, identify operational risks early, conduct root cause analysis, and support the development and implementation of contingency plans. Stakeholder Communication: Maintain effective communication with internal teams, sponsors, clinical investigators and research sites, external customers, and third-party vendors, responding promptly to urgent requests and emerging concerns. Resource Management: Assess project staffing and resource requirements, monitor resource utilization throughout the study life cycle, and support efficient allocation of clinical operations resources. Regulatory Compliance and Quality Assurance: Ensure study activities comply with International Council for Harmonisation Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP), applicable local regulatory requirements, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and operational guidelines. Audit and Inspection Readiness: Prepare for and participate in audits and inspections, maintain accurate study documentation, and support the quality review and upkeep of central study files. Study Close-Out and Data Management: Collaborate with project leaders and data operations teams on database lock, project close-out, documentation, and archiving activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with global project management teams and cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate deliverables, resolve operational challenges, and maintain alignment across study activities. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to process improvement initiatives, document lessons learned during study close-out, and identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and study quality. Team Development: Act as a positive role model, share clinical operations knowledge, and help foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning across virtual teams. Requirements: Education: A degree in life sciences, a nursing qualification, or equivalent relevant clinical or clinical management experience. Clinical Research Experience: Substantial experience in clinical research operations, including experience as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or in an equivalent clinical research role. Clinical Trial Knowledge: Strong understanding of the full clinical trial life cycle, including study start-up, site management, monitoring, data cleaning, close-out, and archiving. Regulatory and Compliance Expertise: Knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, local regulatory requirements, clinical trial procedures, and applicable quality standards. Clinical Coordination Experience: Experience coordinating clinical activities or teams is preferred, particularly experience gained in a Senior CRA or Senior Clinical Management Associate (CMA) position. Monitoring Experience: Previous on-site clinical monitoring experience is an advantage. Leadership and Stakeholder Management: Ability to coordinate virtual teams across different locations and cultures, influence stakeholders diplomatically, negotiate effectively, and build trusted working relationships. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong root cause analysis, issue resolution, and critical-thinking abilities, with the capacity to anticipate risks and implement practical solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent written and spoken English, with proficiency in relevant local languages where required for assigned countries. Organization and Time Management: Strong planning, prioritization, and multitasking skills, combined with attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and a commitment to high-quality work. Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook, as well as WebEx or comparable collaboration tools. Willingness to learn and become proficient in relevant clinical operations systems. Adaptability and Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, respond to changing study needs, and contribute positively to a fast-paced, international environment. Travel Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel when required by assigned studies or project responsibilities. Benefits: Remote Work: Work remotely from India, with the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across global locations. Flexible Work Environment: Be part of an organization that values flexibility and supports employees in doing their best work. Professional Development: Expand your clinical research expertise while developing project coordination, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Career Growth: Gain exposure to small and midsize clinical studies, cross-functional project management, and opportunities to broaden your responsibilities. Collaborative Culture: Work with experienced clinical operations professionals in a diverse, internationally connected team. verification_backlog.title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Serve as the primary administrator for Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, ensuring platform stability, performance, security, and usability. Manage users, profiles, permission sets, roles, access controls, and sharing settings in accordance with business requirements and security best practices. Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Salesforce Flow automations, including record-triggered, scheduled, screen, and HTTP callout flows. Review, rationalize, and migrate legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builder automations to modern Salesforce automation solutions where appropriate. Build and maintain reports and dashboards that provide visibility into sales pipelines, operational performance, subscription revenue, and key business metrics, including monthly recurring revenue (MRR), annual recurring revenue (ARR), and churn. Administer Case Management workflows, assignment rules, service processes, and related automation to improve service delivery and operational efficiency. Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and connected platforms, including NetSuite through Celigo/integrator.io, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Dialpad, PDF Butler, Apollo, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams. Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot API-based and webhook-based integrations to maintain reliable data synchronization across business systems. Support deployment and release management activities across sandbox and production environments using change sets, Metadata API, and Salesforce CLI. Maintain data integrity through validation rules, regular audits, duplicate management, data cleanup, and continuous process improvements. Investigate and resolve end-user issues, provide technical support, and develop clear documentation and training materials to encourage effective platform adoption. Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across departments to understand operational challenges and deliver scalable Salesforce solutions. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve automation, and strengthen Revenue Operations (RevOps) processes. Use AI-assisted tools to support administration, troubleshooting, documentation, and process optimization while maintaining quality and appropriate oversight. Stay informed about Salesforce platform releases, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve the environment. Requirements: 8+ years of hands-on Salesforce Administration experience , preferably in complex, highly automated environments. A valid Salesforce Administrator certification is required. Strong practical expertise in Salesforce Flow automation, including designing, implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting advanced flows. Proven administration experience across both Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Strong understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and access management. Experience managing third-party integrations and troubleshooting API-based and webhook-based data synchronization. Demonstrated ability to build and maintain reports and dashboards for sales, service operations, financial reporting, and business performance monitoring. Experience supporting data quality initiatives, automation improvements, release management, and platform maintenance. Familiarity with Salesforce deployment tools and processes, including change sets, Metadata API, and Salesforce CLI. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex operational and technical issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical processes and explain solutions to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions to improve administration workflows, technical troubleshooting, and documentation. Preferred qualifications: Salesforce Advanced Administrator and/or Platform App Builder certification. Experience integrating Salesforce with NetSuite and middleware platforms such as Celigo/integrator.io. Familiarity with HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Dialpad, PDF Butler, Apollo, or comparable business applications. Experience working with subscription-based business models and metrics, including MRR, ARR, and customer churn. Exposure to low-code/no-code automation practices and Revenue Operations workflows. Salesforce Platform Developer I certification. Experience in healthcare, SaaS, marketing, or agency environments. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Keep shared resources accessible and current across Google Drive and internal knowledge platforms. Data collection and analysis: Design, administer, and analyze biannual membership surveys, including mid-year feedback and end-of-year organizational information surveys. Gather insights from Slack, newsletters, and the member website, identify trends, and produce clear reports to inform strategic decisions and program improvements. Communications and engagement: Coordinate professional, timely, and culturally responsive communications with members worldwide. Prepare and distribute monthly newsletters, highlight member success stories, coordinate annual review content, and manage communications for virtual events, mentorship initiatives, and new programs. verification_backlog.title: Verification of Benefits/Insurance Verification Specialist
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Insurance Benefits Verification: Verify patient insurance eligibility, coverage, benefits, and policy details to ensure information is accurate and complete before services are provided or claims are submitted. Patient and Provider Communication: Communicate with patients, healthcare providers, and insurance representatives to clarify coverage details, confirm benefits, and address insurance-related questions. Documentation and Recordkeeping: Accurately record verification results, update patient information, and maintain complete documentation in electronic health records (EHR) systems and designated verification platforms. Discrepancy Resolution: Identify inconsistencies in insurance information, investigate coverage issues, and follow up on pending verifications to support timely resolution. Medical Billing Support: Collaborate with billing and other internal teams to ensure verified insurance information supports accurate claims preparation and timely submission. Policy and Compliance Management: Stay informed about insurance policies, payer requirements, and verification procedures while adhering to established operational standards and healthcare regulations. Workflow Coordination: Manage verification requests efficiently, prioritize workloads, and maintain turnaround times to support seamless healthcare administrative operations. Team Collaboration and Training: Work with colleagues across departments to improve processes and provide guidance or training to junior team members when required. Quality Assurance: Review verification information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, helping reduce administrative errors and prevent avoidable billing delays. Requirements Professional Experience: At least 3 years of experience in insurance verification, verification of benefits, medical billing, or a closely related healthcare administration role. Medical Billing Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical billing and coding practices, insurance eligibility, benefit structures, coverage limitations, and claims processing workflows. EHR and Verification Systems: Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) systems and insurance verification software, with the ability to navigate digital platforms and maintain accurate patient records. Insurance Verification Expertise: Ability to interpret insurance information, confirm patient benefits, identify discrepancies, and follow up effectively with relevant parties. Healthcare Compliance: Knowledge of HIPAA regulations, patient confidentiality requirements, and applicable healthcare data protection and compliance standards. Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with patients, healthcare providers, and internal stakeholders. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong attention to detail and the ability to investigate discrepancies, assess information accurately, and resolve issues efficiently. Organization and Time Management: Ability to handle multiple verification requests, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent accuracy in a fast-paced environment. Independent Working Style: Comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision while remaining accountable for productivity, documentation quality, and timely follow-up. Teamwork and Adaptability: Willingness to collaborate across departments, adapt to changing workflows, and contribute to continuous process improvement. Benefits Remote Work Opportunity: Work remotely from India. Healthcare Operations Experience: Develop and apply specialized expertise in insurance verification, patient benefits, and medical billing workflows. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with healthcare providers, patients, and internal teams to support efficient administrative and claims processes. Professional Development: Opportunities to strengthen knowledge of insurance policies, EHR systems, verification tools, and healthcare compliance practices. Meaningful Contribution: Help improve billing accuracy, reduce administrative delays, and support a more seamless healthcare experience. verification_backlog.title: Revenue Analytics Analyst
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Metrics definition and governance: Define, document, and certify company-wide business metrics, including ARR, ACV, NDR, GDR, customer count, and employee count, ensuring each metric has a consistent, clearly governed definition. Executive-level reporting: Own the certification of metrics used in company-wide and executive reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting cycles and business reviews. Data quality and reconciliation: Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies across source systems, including Salesforce, NetSuite, customer success platforms, and product data, to maintain the integrity of governed metrics. Governance standards: Establish and maintain data quality controls, data lineage documentation, metric ownership frameworks, and governance processes that can scale with organizational growth. Reporting automation: Partner with business intelligence, data products, AI, and data engineering teams to develop an automation roadmap that reduces manual reconciliation and enables reliable, self-service reporting. Cross-functional alignment: Serve as the primary point of contact for Finance, Go-to-Market, General and Administrative (G&A), Product, and Engineering stakeholders on company-wide metric definitions, reporting questions, and changes to measurement standards. Metric consistency and standardization: Identify and close gaps between departmental reporting practices, ensuring teams use consistent definitions for shared business performance indicators. Continuous improvement: Evaluate existing reporting processes, identify opportunities to improve data reliability and accessibility, and implement scalable solutions that strengthen confidence in business performance insights. Clear ownership boundaries: Maintain centralized ownership of company-wide metrics while enabling functional teams to retain responsibility for their own operational analytics and specialized reporting needs. Requirements At least two years of relevant professional experience in revenue analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, financial analytics, or a related field. Demonstrated experience defining, managing, or governing company-wide business metrics within a B2B Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment. Strong understanding of subscription business metrics, including ARR, ACV, NDR, GDR, customer counts, and related revenue performance indicators. Advanced practical SQL skills, with the ability to query, analyze, reconcile, and validate complex datasets across multiple business systems. Experience working with data from CRM, finance, customer success, and product platforms, ideally including Salesforce and NetSuite. Strong understanding of data quality management, metric standardization, reporting governance, data lineage, and source-of-truth management. Ability to investigate data discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions that improve reporting accuracy and consistency. Familiarity with business intelligence tools, data products, data engineering workflows, and reporting automation initiatives. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data issues into clear, actionable recommendations. Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities, including the confidence to align cross-functional teams on metric definitions and governance standards. A detail-oriented, structured, and proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a remote environment. A strong sense of ownership and accountability for the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of business-critical data. Benefits Competitive compensation: Annual salary ranging from INR 15,00,000 to INR 25,00,000 (₹15–25 LPA), depending on experience and suitability. Fully remote work: Work remotely from India, offering flexibility without the need for a daily office commute. Strategic business impact: Influence executive-level decision-making by ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the company's most important performance metrics. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Finance, GTM, Product, Engineering, and data specialists across the organization. Professional development: Strengthen your expertise in revenue analytics, data governance, subscription business metrics, and enterprise reporting. Data and automation focus: Contribute to initiatives that modernize reporting, improve data quality, and enable scalable, self-service analytics. Ownership and autonomy: Take responsibility for establishing trusted metric definitions and governance standards across the business. Full-time opportunity: Build your career in a role that combines technical analytics expertise with strategic business partnership. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? verification_backlog.title: Quality Specialist
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Maintain awareness of applicable GxP guidelines and regulatory requirements, ensuring that quality processes and service delivery activities remain compliant with established standards. Support and coordinate electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) activities, including change control, deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and effectiveness checks. Develop, recommend, monitor, and document deviations, quality events, and corrective and preventive actions, ensuring appropriate root cause analysis and effective resolution. Review, approve, and communicate root cause investigation findings and CAPA plans to relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear documentation and accountability. Conduct effectiveness checks to verify that corrective and preventive actions have addressed identified issues and reduced the likelihood of recurrence. Participate in GxP change management activities, including risk and impact assessments, change plan reviews and approvals, implementation monitoring, and tracking actions through completion. Coordinate client audits and regulatory inspections, including preparing agendas, organizing required documentation, arranging logistics, and ensuring relevant subject matter experts are available. Coordinate audit-related CAPA responses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to prepare accurate, comprehensive, and timely responses. Maintain audit and inspection records in the eQMS, ensuring that documentation is complete, accurate, appropriately stored, and tracked through closure. Generate quality reports and analyze data related to deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to quality systems, procedures, and operational processes. For medical information quality assurance activities, retrospectively evaluate telephone interactions and case reports to verify compliance with applicable procedures and quality standards. Collaborate with internal teams, quality stakeholders, and clients to support continuous improvement, strengthen compliance, and maintain high service quality. Undertake additional quality-related responsibilities as needed to support evolving business and operational requirements. Requirements A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in a suitable discipline is required. At least 2 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance role. Working knowledge of GxP quality management systems and the regulatory requirements applicable to quality-related activities. Experience with quality management processes, including deviations, quality events, CAPAs, effectiveness checks, and change control, is preferred. Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), including quality record management, documentation, reporting, and data analysis. Strong understanding of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action planning, risk assessment, and continuous improvement methodologies. Excellent organizational, prioritization, project management, and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage several activities and deadlines simultaneously. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to build effective professional relationships with clients, internal teams, management, and cross-functional stakeholders. Strong customer service skills and a collaborative approach to resolving quality issues and supporting internal and external stakeholders. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining proactive, flexible, and responsive to changing priorities. A professional attitude, openness to change, and the ability to contribute positively to a diverse, collaborative, and quality-driven environment. Preferred: Experience conducting Medical Information Quality Assurance reviews, particularly evaluating recorded telephone calls and case reports in a call center environment. Benefits Flexible working arrangements: Remote working opportunities in India, with potential hybrid arrangements for employees located within a reasonable commuting distance of an office, as agreed with their manager. Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in quality assurance, GxP compliance, quality management systems, and regulatory processes. Meaningful contribution: The opportunity to support quality and compliance activities that contribute to reliable healthcare and pharmaceutical services. Collaborative environment: Opportunities to work with cross-functional teams, subject matter experts, and clients on quality improvement initiatives. Continuous learning: Exposure to audits, regulatory inspections, quality investigations, and process improvement activities. Inclusive workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and creating an environment where employees can contribute authentically and develop their skills. Career growth: Opportunities to expand quality assurance expertise and take on additional responsibilities as business needs evolve.
